newsitem.title: USA: US jet fuel steady in New York, eases in Gulf.
newsitem.headline: US jet fuel steady in New York, eases in Gulf.

text.p: U.S. cash jet fuel prices held steady in New York Harbor but edged lower in the Gulf Coast amid slightly firmer October futures but lower November NYMEX values, players said.
New York Harbor 54-grade jet was little changed as differentials held steady and October futures edged only marginally higher, traders said, with offers about 0.35 cent above the print.
Gulf Coast 54-grade slipped about 0.25 cent with November futures, although diffs remained about 1.60 cents below the print, traders said.
